# Tong's Information - Demo

> A Swiss modernist digital publication authored for human eyes and AI agents
> 一份写给人类眼睛与 AI Agent 的瑞士现代主义数字刊物

## Agent Discovery & Machine Endpoints
- Full bilingual corpus: https://info-demo.esoren.com/llms-full.txt
- Structured catalog JSON: https://info-demo.esoren.com/api/posts.json
- Concept topology graph JSON: https://info-demo.esoren.com/api/graph.json
- Stream (fragments) JSON: https://info-demo.esoren.com/api/stream.json
- Stream Markdown twins: https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/stream/index.md | https://info-demo.esoren.com/stream/index.md
- Stream RSS feeds: https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/stream/rss.xml | https://info-demo.esoren.com/stream/rss.xml
- English RSS / JSON Feed: https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/rss.xml | https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/feed.json
- Chinese RSS / JSON Feed: https://info-demo.esoren.com/rss.xml | https://info-demo.esoren.com/feed.json

## Issues (English Markdown Twins)
- [Issue 05 (FEATURE): The Dual-Audience Web: Publishing for Human Eyes and AI Agents](https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/posts/dual-audience-web/index.md): An architectural blueprint for dual-surface static publishing, complete with a live Human/Agent Representation Inspector and a Swiss Modular Grid Workbench.
- [Issue 04 (FEATURE): Quiet Interfaces: Designing Beyond the Click](https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/posts/ambient-interfaces/index.md): An inquiry into chrome fatigue and intent-driven surfaces, complete with a live Interface Noise-to-Signal Calibrator.
- [Issue 03 (ESSAY): Thinking in Stereo: Writing Beyond Monolingual Boundaries](https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/posts/bilingual-thought/index.md): Why maintaining idiomatic Chinese and English editions sharpens thought itself — featuring a margin double-click gesture that unfolds each paragraph's counterpart language in place.
- [Issue 02 (ESSAY): Readable in Ten Years: Static HTML and the Half-Life of Digital Work](https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/posts/software-longevity/index.md): Measuring the half-life of personal publishing stacks across a ten-year horizon, from dynamic CMS databases to zero-dependency static HTML on the edge.
- [Issue 01 (ESSAY): Beyond Templates: Why Personal Publishing Belongs to Agent-Authored HTML](https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/posts/agent-era-publishing/index.md): The founding thesis of Tong's Information: separating structural order from creative layout to achieve a zero-framework, entropy-resistant, agent-bilingual static publication.

## 刊物目录（中文 Markdown 孪生原稿）
- [第 05 期（FEATURE）：双面万维网：同时写给人类眼睛与 AI Agent 的出版架构](https://info-demo.esoren.com/posts/dual-audience-web/index.md): 拆解“一文双面”的静态出版范式，内置「人类/Agent 透视实验室」与「瑞士网格字阶实验台」两套零依赖交互装置。
- [第 04 期（FEATURE）：宁静界面：当交互从点击转向意图](https://info-demo.esoren.com/posts/ambient-interfaces/index.md): 剖析界面过度装饰的根源，并内置「界面信噪比校准器」交互装置，实时对比控件堆砌与克制意图界面之间的视觉熵值。
- [第 03 期（ESSAY）：双语即思考：Agent 时代的写作不再被单一语言围困](https://info-demo.esoren.com/posts/bilingual-thought/index.md): 讨论中英双语写作如何反哺逻辑清晰度，并支持在段落左右留白处双击唤醒当前段落的英文对照版本。
- [第 02 期（ESSAY）：十年之后依然可读：静态网页与数字资产的半衰期](https://info-demo.esoren.com/posts/software-longevity/index.md): 以数字出版物的半衰期为线索，对比动态栈、重型构建链与零依赖纯静态 HTML 在十年尺度下的维护成本与可迁移性。
- [第 01 期（ESSAY）：后模板时代：为什么个人出版物应该由 Agent 直接书写 HTML](https://info-demo.esoren.com/posts/agent-era-publishing/index.md): 阐述 Tong's Information 的发刊哲学：如何通过秩序层与创意层分离，实现零框架、抗熵增、原生双语的静态出版工作流。

## Core Concepts
- **Agent Web / Agent 万维网** (`agent-web`): Designing websites simultaneously as human reading surfaces and machine-consumable knowledge protocols.
- **Interface Craft / 界面克制与意图设计** (`interface-craft`): Stripping away decorative chrome and control clutter so interfaces serve human intent quietly.
- **Static Architecture / 纯静态架构** (`static-architecture`): Leaving heavy build chains and dependency rot behind in favor of durable, native web standards.
- **Swiss Typography / 瑞士排印与网格** (`swiss-typography`): Building rational reading order through modular grids, typographic hierarchy, hairlines, and negative space.
- **Agent-Native i18n / Agent 原生双语** (`bilingual-i18n`): Writing from a single source of thought while an agent editorial desk crafts idiomatic bilingual editions.
- **Knowledge Graph / 思想图谱** (`knowledge-graph`): Replacing flat chronological feeds with conceptual topology and bidirectional links.
- **Edge Architecture / 边缘演进架构** (`edge-architecture`): Hosting on Cloudflare Workers Static Assets for zero-ops static delivery today with seamless upgrades to content negotiation and MCP tomorrow.

## Stream (Recent Fragments)
- [#005 (2026-11-25 · SNIPPET)](https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/stream/#t-005): Adding `view-transition-class` turns list filtering from an abrupt hide/show snap into archival index cards gliding cleanly along a rail — all in under ten lines of CSS. / 给碎片流加上 `view-transition-class` 之后，筛选分类不再是生硬的显隐跳变，而是像活页纸片顺着导轨滑入新位置——核心 CSS 不到十行。
- [#004 (2026-11-22 · QUESTION)](https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/stream/#t-004): Once `llms.txt` and clean `index.md` twins give AI agents a dedicated high-signal channel, can human-facing HTML finally stop flattening itself into plain text and become a tactile visual medium again? / 既然 `llms.txt` 和 `index.md` 已经替 AI Agent 铺好了极致纯净的高信噪比管道，那人类访问的 HTML 网页是不是终于可以卸下“信息喂食槽”的包袱，重新做回一件值得凝视的视觉作品？
- [#003 (2026-11-16 · QUOTE)](https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/stream/#t-003): A steady reminder whenever the urge strikes to wrap a control in one more border or slap a status dot on a heading. Restraint isn't scarcity; it lets typography and whitespace carry the room. / 每次忍不住想给按钮外再套一层边框或加个状态红点时，就把这句话贴在眼前。克制不是贫瘠，而是让真正重要的文字与留白自己说话。
- [#002 (2026-11-08 · MUSING)](https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/stream/#t-002): An idea written in Chinese often lands with aphoristic compression, yet translating it into idiomatic English immediately exposes every unspoken premise. Bilingual publishing isn't just wider reach — it's a built-in calibration mirror for thought. / 同一个想法，用中文写出来往往凝练如金句，转成英文时却会立刻暴露隐含的前提和逻辑跳步。双语出版不只是多照顾一拨读者，更像自带一面逻辑校准镜。
- [#001 (2026-10-30 · MUSING)](https://info-demo.esoren.com/en/stream/#t-001): First studio note on the ledger: no bundler, no runtime framework. Ten years from now, on any machine that can still open a browser, double-clicking these plain HTML and Markdown files should still read cleanly. / 开卷第一条手记：不装任何构建器，不依赖运行时框架。十年后随便找一台还能打开浏览器的设备，双击这几个纯文本与 HTML 文件，它们应该依然读得清清楚楚。
